items.markdown:
![The Two Matt Pocock Skills I Use in Almost Every AI Coding ...](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10220854-1430-0139-0000-12adecd4309f:4)
Matt Pocock created [mattpocock/skills](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills), `an open-source collection of AI agent prompts, markdown files, and slash commands designed for real software engineering workflows rather than casual "vibe coding"`.[[1]](https://www.aihero.dev/skills)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/HYQBYWY1pns)

You can install the full set using Node.js:

```bash
npx skills@latest add mattpocock/skills
```



---

### Core Engineering & Workflow Skills

- **`ask-matt`** : Acts as a router to help you select which skill or flow fits your current engineering task.
- **`grill-with-docs`** : Interviews you relentlessly to shape requirements, sharpens terminology, and updates your project's `GLOSSARY.md` and Architecture Decision Records (`ADRs`).
- **`to-spec`** : Converts ongoing conversation context into a formal software specification and pushes it to your issue tracker.
- **`to-tickets`** : Breaks down a spec into manageable, incremental implementation tickets designed to stay inside a model's low-token "smart zone".
- **`triage`** : Moves issues through a structured state machine of triage roles and labels (`needs-triage`, `needs-info`, `ready-for-agent`, `ready-for-human`, `wontfix`).
- **`improve-codebase-architecture`** : Scans a codebase for structural improvements, generates a visual HTML report, and lets you drill down into architectural fixes.
- **`setup-matt-pocock-skills`** : Configures your repository once (issue tracker, triage labels, and domain doc layout).[[1]](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills)[[2]](https://www.aihero.dev/skills-ask-matt)[[3]](https://newsletter.pragmaticengineer.com/p/ai-skills-with-matt-pocock)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1MNSJhCGMLY)[[5]](https://blog.alexrusin.com/matt-pocock-skills-main-flow/)[[6]](https://www.aihero.dev/skills-setup-matt-pocock-skills)



---

### Shaping & Reference Skills

- **Shaping & Planning**: `/wayfinder`, `/prototype`, `/research`, `/grill-me` 
- **Engineering & Coding**: `/diagnosing-bugs`, `/wizard`, `/implement-spec`, `/triage` 
- **Productivity & Teaching**: `/teach`, `/handoff`, `/to-questionnaire`, `/wait-what`, `/writing-for-agents` 
- **Reference & Architecture**: `/pr`, `/codebase-design`, `/domain-modeling`, `/grilling`, `/tdd` [[1]](https://newsletter.pragmaticengineer.com/p/ai-skills-with-matt-pocock)[[2]](https://www.aihero.dev/skills)[[3]](https://www.aihero.dev/skills-teach)
